findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sleepers_and_busts · Public sink: draft_board, best_available, sleepers_and_busts, adp_market_gaps, who_do_i_draft · Destructive: best_available, who_do_i_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sleepers_and_busts · Public sink: draft_board, best_available, sleepers_and_busts, adp_market_gaps, who_do_i_draft · Destructive: best_available, who_do_i_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "draft_board" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
